entries.description: Conkers falling freely, leaves yellowing and browning, first autumn colour on chestnut avenues
entries.childFriendlyNote: Conkers rain down from the trees — collect the shiniest ones and feel how smooth they are!

entries.description: Cep mushrooms still appearing after rain, chanterelles and other edible fungi in mixed woodland
entries.childFriendlyNote: Mushroom treasure hunt! After rain, the forest floor is dotted with all kinds of weird and wonderful fungi!

entries.description: Beech trees turning copper and gold, one of the most spectacular autumn colour trees in Europe
entries.childFriendlyNote: The beech trees are turning the colour of a shiny new penny — copper and gold leaves glow in the sun!

entries.description: Starling flocks building, pre-roost aerial displays beginning over cities and reed beds
entries.childFriendlyNote: Watch the starlings gather at sunset — they swirl around in the sky like a magic cloud that changes shape!

entries.description: Red squirrels busy caching hazelnuts and acorns, burying them in the ground for winter stores
entries.childFriendlyNote: Bushy-tailed red squirrels dash around burying nuts — they're hiding snacks for winter but sometimes forget where!

entries.description: Beech trees turning copper and gold, one of the most spectacular autumn colour trees in Europe
entries.childFriendlyNote: The beech trees are turning the colour of a shiny new penny — copper and gold leaves glow in the sun!

entries.childFriendlyNote: Watch the starlings gather at sunset — they swirl around in the sky like a magic cloud that changes shape!

entries.childFriendlyNote: Conkers rain down from the trees — collect the shiniest ones and feel how smooth they are!

entries.description: Cep mushrooms still appearing after rain, chanterelles and other edible fungi in mixed woodland
entries.childFriendlyNote: Mushroom treasure hunt! After rain, the forest floor is dotted with all kinds of weird and wonderful fungi!

entries.description: Beech trees turning copper and gold, one of the most spectacular autumn colour trees in Europe
entries.childFriendlyNote: The beech trees are turning the colour of a shiny new penny — copper and gold leaves glow in the sun!

entries.description: Starling flocks building, pre-roost aerial displays beginning over cities and reed beds
entries.childFriendlyNote: Watch the starlings gather at sunset — they swirl around in the sky like a magic cloud that changes shape!

entries.description: Red squirrels busy caching hazelnuts and acorns, burying them in the ground for winter stores
entries.childFriendlyNote: Bushy-tailed red squirrels dash around burying nuts — they're hiding snacks for winter but sometimes forget where!
